source.rule: A single PMID can have intervals in multiple OPIDs; whichever counter reaches its limit first initiates the task and resets all counters of that PMID. MONIT=Y stores relevant PM counters per physical item.

hypothesis_before_native.common: The one-time SYS-SWAP at h10 installs a zero-prelife stocked spare ID1 and returns original ID0 after unrelated PMID overhaul. Four two-hour missions succeed if supply and maintenance remain available.
hypothesis_before_native.ophours-only: Without a MISSIONS interval, stocked item ID1 accrues four OPHOURS by h34, below interval 5, so its first LRU-MIX task waits until h46 after six OPHOURS. Original ID0 remains stocked until then.
hypothesis_before_native.missions-plus-ophours: With MISSIONS=2 added to the same monitored item PMID, stocked item ID1 reaches two missions by h34 while below OPHOURS5, causing LRU-MIX h34 and original ID0 reinstallation. ID0's second lifetime mission ends h46, so its monitored MISSIONS counter should cause LRU-MIX h46 despite only four cumulative OPHOURS.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms must import/export exact authored rows, calculate with zero conversion errors and no incomplete PM runtime warning, preserve GUI/queue/session guards, and seal nonempty event/report evidence.
The arms must differ only by the MISSIONS2 MaterielPMInterval row and descriptive text; all other PM, stock, mission, seed and horizon data must match.

Mission outcomes, PMID-specific task timing, physical item IDs, stock route and 96 aligned half-hour System/Stock report bins must reconcile. If the predicted h34 contrast is absent, reject or narrow the multi-counter claim.
A separate read-only reviewer must replay frozen source and raw evidence without importing author implementation.
limits: One seed, one aircraft, one installed and one stocked LRU, a one-time system swap and one extra MISSIONS counter only.
The native report does not expose the winning counter or numeric per-item counter values; attribution to MISSIONS requires the isolated arm contrast and threshold arithmetic.
No initial prelife, counter ties, anticipation/deferment, other intervals, GUI visual or cross-engine claim.
